public_rationale: The search found a documented regulatory setback in Wisconsin and Oracle's statement that 75% of Abilene's capacity had been delivered. Neither settles the claim as written. The first does not establish delays at every campus. The second does not independently resolve the disputed meaning of installed capacity. Treating delivered buildings as installed compute would decide the result through an assumption.
limitations: Oracle's statement comes from a third-party transcript of the company call.
The latest completed monthly period is an evaluator choice.
Project-wide delay risk is different from an already missed delivery milestone.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every Stargate data center is heavily behind schedule, and Stargate Abilene has no more than half its capacity installed despite Oracle's '75% delivered' claim.

statement.excerpt: Every one of the “Stargate” data centers is heavily behind schedule, and Stargate Abilene — which Oracle claims is “75% delivered” — has no more than half of its capacity installed, not that anyone bothers to check these things or investigate the claims of anyone connected to the AI bubble.

from_speaker: Every one of the “Stargate” data centers
no more than half of its capacity installed
our_interpretation: Read 'every one' as all announced Stargate campuses, not merely Abilene.
Read 'heavily behind schedule' as substantial slippage against previously announced construction or service milestones.

Read 'capacity installed' as installed computing equipment relative to the planned completed campus, using a consistent capacity measure. Building delivery, electrical capacity and operating compute are not automatically equivalent.
Use September 2026, the latest completed monthly construction-reporting period before publication, for the ongoing observation. Evidence must also remain relevant to the October 6 statement.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable original schedules and progress records establish substantial delays at every included campus, and equipment records establish that Abilene had at most 50% of its planned computing capacity installed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that at least one included campus was not substantially delayed, or that more than 50% of Abilene's planned computing capacity was installed.
